storage: Only changed snapshots are archived: WZDx (about 124 KB gzipped a fetch, every 5 min) in $TVT_ARCHIVE/wzdx/, the 511 API's changed responses in $TVT_ARCHIVE/idaho511/; events in evt.event (core's lifecycle table), sign messages and road-weather readings in this plugin's tables.
ethics: 511 Idaho's API is used under its developer terms with the owner's key, at most 8 calls a minute; its data isn't republished (the OK to republish covers WZDx only). 511's list pages and /map/map*/ endpoints are off-limits for collection. WZDx may be republished, raw or aggregated, crediting ITD (owner, Oct 6, 2026).
